title: A trustline created by a Stellar Asset Contract call produces no trustline state change
severity_basis: Silent partial drop of a balance-relevant state change: ingestion completes, the transaction and the current-state balance are stored, the trustline_created state change is missing. Executed at the pre-fix commit; fixed upstream.

entries.expected: a trustline_created state change for the account the SAC call created the trustline for
entries.observed: Executed at 764a4f5b on the Protocol 28 variants (also Protocols 26 and 27; both passphrases; both inputs; single ledger and whole chain): ingestion reaches the ledger with no error, the transaction, the operation and the fee row are stored and the current-state balance table holds the new trustline, but no TRUSTLINE/ADD and no BALANCE_AUTHORIZATION/SET state change exists. Executed at c152783c an

evidence.pre_fix: wallet-backend 764a4f5b through the replay harness (make verify-replay), Protocol 28 variants, both passphrases, both inputs: dropped · partial.
evidence.post_fix: wallet-backend c152783c and the pinned current commit e967ce8b: pass (make verify-replay).
evidence.expected_basis: The ledger meta of the local stellar-core run shows the TRUSTLINE ledger entry created by the SAC trust call (CAP-73).

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 2 of 2 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0014.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added.
